Welcome to Tiny Giants, an imaginary studio where architecture meets storytelling. From a street corner with a secret to a house at the edge of everywhere, we build places that feel wonderfully alive.

Paper, paint, wood, and a little bit of magic. Every model is an invitation to imagine what happens next.
